result.title: Evolutionary Adaptive Metric Learning: A Multi-Objective Framework for Learning Local Distance Functions in Nearest Neighbor Classification
result.summary: Nearest neighbour classifiers inherit the geometry of their distance function. Fixed distances and globally learned metrics apply the same geometry throughout the input space, although relevant feature directions may vary across regions. We propose EAML (Evolutionary Adaptive Metric Learning), a framework that learns instance-dependent positive-definite metrics through a low-dimensional parameterization. Each local metric combines an input-dependent diagonal scaling, generated by softmax interpolation between anchor points, with a global low-rank correlation component. A real-coded elitist genetic algorithm optimizes the parameters using a scalar objective combining leave-one-out prediction error, robustness, metric smoothness, and regularization. We establish positive definiteness, metric equivalence, existence of an optimal solution, and Lipschitz continuity of the metric field. We further investigate prediction stability, generalization bounds, and evolutionary convergence under explicit assumptions. Experiments on synthetic data with region-dependent feature relevance show that EAML can recover local metric variations and outperform global metrics. Evaluation on thirteen public datasets using nested 5-fold cross-validation reveals a more nuanced picture: EAML improves performance on selected datasets but does not significantly outperform global metric baselines overall. Additional experiments show that global diagonal metrics can be preferable under nuisance features and test-time noise. These findings identify the conditions under which evolutionary local metric learning is beneficial and highlight its practical limitations.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 EAML：以锚点间 softmax 插值的对角缩放叠加全局低秩相关分量，构造实例相关的正定距离函数，用 elitist 遗传算法优化，并给出正定性、光滑性、泛化与收敛性分析；多个公开数据集上局部度量仅在部分数据有效，整体未显著优于全局度量。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文的局部度量场、光滑性与正定约束，以及“噪声/冗余特征下全局度量反而更优”的负结果，可能为 latent 相似度度量的几何正则化与评估设计提供可核查的类比线索，但与 VLM 推理无直接联系。
